chunks: And he (peace be upon him) said:
The faith of a servant is not considered true until his trust in what is with Allah, Exalted is He, is stronger than his trust in what is in his own hand.
ai.seo_question: What is the condition for faith to be considered true according to Imam Ali?
ai.summary: Imam Ali (peace be upon him) defines true faith (iman) as being rooted in complete trust in God surpassing trust in one's own possessions or self. This hadith emphasizes that genuine belief requires a shift in reliance from material security to divine providence, a concept central to Shia theological discussions on *tawakkul* versus *tawakkul al-gharir* (reliance on one's own efforts). It serves as a practical benchmark for believers to evaluate the depth of their conviction by comparing their confidence in worldly means against their confidence in Allah’s decree.
